why: Each row has one curved-down (U) body, one flat body and one arched body, and legs 2, 3 and 4. The body decides the legs: U body has legs with bent feet, flat body has plain straight legs, arched body has legs with round dots. Row 3 is missing the flat body with 2 legs, so it needs 2 plain legs: option 5. Option 2 is flat with 2 legs but has bent feet, which belong to the U body.
trick: Count legs in each row (2, 3, 4 once each) and match the leg-end style to the body shape.
note: Some heads look grey (dotted) and some black in the scan; drawn as seen. Head colour is not part of the rule.
